about: Derived by scripts/secret_material_census.py; verdicts are reviewed by hand.

verdicts.wiped: the frame drops the name before any raise propagates: the function body is a `try` whose `except BaseException:` deletes it and re-raises (for a local or an environment read, its binding is the statement right before the `try`); a closure cell is wiped by its enclosing function and the nested function never escapes it
verdicts.boxed: the material is held only in a `decoy_engine._opaque.OpaqueBox` (fixed repr) and unboxed inside the call expression that consumes it; a boxed parameter is boxed and deleted by the first two statements
verdicts.unbound: the value is consumed inside an expression and never bound to a name
verdicts.hidden: a class attribute a repr would print: the dataclass field is `repr=False` or the class defines its own `__repr__`
verdicts.contained: the function runs only under the admission boundary `_call_closed`, which re-raises a fresh exception with no traceback through it
verdicts.no-raise: no raise is reachable while the name is live; the reason says why
verdicts.not-secret: the name matched but the value is not secret material; the reason says why
